supported_pph.desc: Pajak Pembelian Barang Impor / BUMN / Penyerahan Goods
Pajak Jasa & Sewa (Tarif umum 2% untuk Jasa, 15% untuk Bunga/Dividen)

tax_and_accounting_rules.calculation_panel_features: Real-time DPP (Dasar Pengenaan Pajak) input, auto PPN toggle, auto PPh picker, Gross/Net computation breakdown, Tax ID/Faktur Pajak validation field.

core_forms_and_flows.name: Permintaan Pengadaan Barang & Jasa
core_forms_and_flows.purpose: Pengajuan kebutuhan barang/jasa dari Dept User dengan verifikasi anggaran.

core_forms_and_flows.name: Permohonan Uang Muka
core_forms_and_flows.purpose: Permintaan dana cash advance sebelum realisasi transaksi.

core_forms_and_flows.name: Permohonan Pembayaran
core_forms_and_flows.purpose: Pengajuan pembayaran vendor/faktur lengkap dengan kalkulasi potongan PPh & PPN.

core_forms_and_flows.name: Pertanggungjawaban Uang Muka
core_forms_and_flows.purpose: Settlement pencocokan nota riil vs PUM dengan pengembalian sisa atau klaim kekurangan.

core_forms_and_flows.name: General Ledger Generator
core_forms_and_flows.purpose: Otomatisasi pasangan Debit/Kredit COA Accurate Online beserta rincian hutang pajak.

testing_and_qa.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, input fields, status chips, action buttons, filter selectors, and summary cards MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='ppbj-create-button', data-testid='tax-pph23-rate-input', data-testid='jurnal-export-excel-button').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure the UI uses .js or .jsx file extensions for React components.
Use accurate Indonesian financial terms (DPP, PPN, PPh, COA, Permohonan Pembayaran, Pertanggungjawaban Uang Muka, Jurnal Umum, Accurate Online).
Never hide header or dropdown backgrounds completely transparent.
Ensure multi-level approval matrix clearly displays badges for Supervisor, Finance Manager, and Director.
Provide clear export mechanisms (CSV & Excel) for Jurnal Umum tables matching Accurate Online column formats.
